messages:
dara: Heads up 1 - we hit a subtle failure mode: runtime failover chain private->dedicated->hosted caused a silent model downgrade. Short thread on proposed contract changes.

mai: thanks. what happened exactly?

dara: sequence: private had model pinned v3, capacity low -> runtime tried dedicated variant (v3-quant) which worked, then later fallback to hosted picked v2 (different family). Client observed reduced answer quality.

trent: root cause is current fallback predicates treat "compatible" as "any quantized variant". we need a clearer predicate matrix: semantic_compat, family_match, seq_len_ok, truncation_risk.

mai: agree. proposal: add explicit manifest field spec.fallback.predicate_order = ["family_match","semantic_compat","cost"]. If tenant sets strict_family=true then family_match is mandatory.

sec-bot: security note: tenants can forbid hosted fallbacks entirely via spec.fallback.allow_hosted=false. audit log will fire on attempted fallbacks.

trent: runtime change: before switching to hosted, evaluate predicted_truncation_risk(context_len, seq_limit) and reject fallback if risk > 0.1 for strict tenants.

dara: simple example code for predicate check: ```
if strict_family and !same_family(candidate, pinned) { reject }
if predicted_truncation_risk > manifest.threshold { reject }
accept if cost_ok && latency_ok
```

mai: ops: if strict rejects cause outage, runtime should notify controlplane and create a tenant-alert (not auto-fallback). We prefer human-in-the-loop for strict pins.

deploy-bot: deploy note: 6312345680 - canary window reserved for predicate rollout next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC.

trent: owners: runtime (trent) for predicate engine, controlplane (mai) for manifest schema + notification plumbing, security (sec-bot) for policy.

dara: action items: 1) draft manifest change PR (mai) 2) runtime predicate prototype + tests (trent) 3) add metric fallback.predicate.reject_reason 4) docs + tenant migration guide.

mai: will open manifest PR today and tag reviewers.

trent: i'll prototype predicate in runtime branch and post perf numbers.

dara: great. let's keep this conservative for canary. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
